definitions.explanation: The highest or most extreme point of something, especially skill, beauty, or achievement. Used to express that something has reached its absolute peak.

examples.english: It is the pinnacle of beauty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極致|きょくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I witnessed the height of craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極致|きょくち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{過言|かごん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It is no exaggeration to say this dish is the pinnacle of Japanese cuisine.

notes: Composed of ⟦{極|きょく}→極：13150_kyoku⟧ (extreme, utmost) + {致|ち} (reach, attain). Always expresses something at its absolute highest level — carries a tone of admiration or awe. Common collocations: 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極致|きょくち} (the pinnacle of ~), {極致|きょくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧ (to reach the pinnacle), {極致|きょくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧ (to attain the ultimate degree). Often used in artistic, cultural, or culinary criticism. Similar to ⟦{頂点|ちょうてん}→頂点：05448_chouten⟧ (summit, peak), but {極致|きょくち} has a more literary and evaluative tone, emphasizing the supreme quality rather than just the top position.
